description:
Be visionary 
 
 Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research. ​ 
 
 We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.
   
 Job Description 
   
 About Teledyne FLIR Defense 
 Join Teledyne FLIR Defense, where we're dedicated to safeguarding lives with cutting-edge sensing and threat detection technologies. Our arsenal includes advanced surveillance sensors, handheld devices, unmanned vehicles, lasers, and more solutions that increase operational effectiveness for warfighters, first responders, and search-and-rescue teams.
 
 We're looking for passionate innovators eager to shape the future of the Defense industry. If you’re mission-driven to globally collaborate on life-saving solutions, we invite you to explore our current opportunities.
 
 #TeledyneFLIRDefenseJobs
 
 Job Summary: 
 Teledyne FLIR is seeking a versatile Software Engineer to develop user-friendly applications that integrate with handheld and stationary radiation detection systems. This role focuses on designing, developing, and maintaining software across embedded, desktop, web, and mobile platforms while working closely with firmware, hardware, systems, and cross-functional engineering teams.
 The ideal candidate is a full-stack application developer who enjoys building intuitive user experiences, understands how software interfaces with embedded devices, and can contribute throughout the software development lifecycle. This position offers opportunities to work on radiation detection instruments, cloud-connected solutions, and next-generation software platforms.
 
 ** US Citizenship is required for this position. We are unable to hire Green Card Holders, individuals who need a work visa, are currently on a work visa, or individuals who will require work visa sponsorship in the future. ** 
 
 Primary Responsibilities 
 Application Development 
 Design, develop, maintain, and enhance desktop, embedded, web, and mobile applications for Teledyne FLIR products.
 Develop applications using .NET, C#, C++, JavaScript/TypeScript, and other modern development technologies.
 Create intuitive, responsive, and maintainable user interfaces for desktop, web, mobile, and embedded platforms.
 Design and implement user interfaces for embedded devices operating in constrained hardware environments.
 Develop and maintain web applications hosted on embedded platforms and connected devices.
 Develop native and cross-platform applications that interface with radiation detection instruments.
 Implement and integrate REST APIs, WebSocket communications, and backend services.
 Support mobile application development for iOS and Android using cross-platform frameworks when appropriate.
 Contribute to cloud-connected and IoT-enabled application development.
 Software Engineering & Product Development 
 Participate in the design, architecture, implementation, and maintenance of software systems.
 Collaborate with hardware, firmware, systems, and software engineering teams to deliver integrated solutions.
 Identify, analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects in both new and legacy applications.
 Write high-quality, maintainable, well-documented, and secure code.
 Participate in Agile development activities, code reviews, technical discussions, and architecture decisions.
 Develop automated tests, unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end validation processes.
 Support CI/CD pipelines and continuous improvement initiatives.
 Learn and adopt new technologies, frameworks, libraries, and tools to support new product development.
 Provide technical support to customers and internal teams when required.
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Due to program requirements – you must be a U.S. Citizen.
 Education 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
 Experience 
 Minimum 3 years of experience developing desktop, web, mobile, or embedded software applications.
 Experience developing desktop applications using .NET and C#.
 Experience developing software in C++, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, or related languages.
 Experience developing modern user interfaces with a strong focus on usability and user experience.
 Experience integrating software with hardware devices, embedded systems, or connected products.
 Understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and maintainable application development.
 Desktop & Web Technologies 
 Experience with modern desktop UI frameworks such as: WPF
 Avalonia
 WinUI
 Qt
 Similar technologies
 
 Experience developing web applications using frameworks such as: Vue.js
 React
 Angular
 Similar technologies
 
 Proficiency with: HTML
 CSS
 JavaScript
 REST APIs
 WebSockets
 
 Experience creating and consuming backend services and APIs.
 Experience with GraphQL is a plus.
 Mobile Development 
 Experience developing mobile applications for iOS and Android.
 Experience with cross-platform frameworks such as: .NET MAUI
 Flutter
 React Native
 Similar technologies
 
 Understanding of mobile deployment, testing, and lifecycle management.
 Embedded UI Development 
 Experience developing graphical user interfaces for embedded systems.
 Familiarity with: Qt
 Avalonia
 LVGL
 Similar embedded UI frameworks
 
 Understanding of software development within limited-resource embedded environments.
 Software Engineering Practices 
 Experience using source control systems such as Git.
 Familiarity with bug tracking, version control, and continuous integration tools.
 Experience working in Agile development environments.
 Ability to troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex software issues.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 Ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
 Experience working in both Windows and Linux development environments.
 Familiarity with secure software development and cybersecurity best practices.
 
 Programming Languages 
 Proficiency in one or more of the following:
 C
 C++
 C#
 Python
 JavaScript / TypeScript
 Swift
 Java
 Kotlin
 Experience with scripting languages such as Python or Bash is preferred.
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Embedded Systems 
 Experience developing software for embedded Linux systems.
 Knowledge of ARM processor architectures.
 Experience with kernel, BSP, or device driver development.
 Familiarity with: Yocto Project
 RTOS configuration
 Embedded Linux build systems
 
 Experience with communication protocols including: UART
 SPI
 I2C
 CAN
 USB
 Bluetooth
 Ethernet
 GPS
 Wireless technologies
 
 Cloud & IoT 
 Experience developing cloud-connected or IoT-enabled applications.
 Familiarity with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud platforms.
 Experience with: MQTT
 WebSockets
 Device provisioning
 Telemetry
 Remote device management
 
 Understanding of edge computing architectures.
 Backend & Server Development 
 Experience developing scalable backend services using: .NET
 Node.js
 Python
 Similar technologies
 
 Familiarity with Docker and containerization technologies.
 Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.
 Understanding of API security, authentication, and authorization.
 Domain Knowledge 
 Background in physics, radiation detection, gamma/neutron spectroscopy, or scientific instrumentation is preferred but not required.
 
 #FLIR
 
   
 Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.
 
 Teledyne is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other characteristic or non-merit based factor made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws. ​
